indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 75% of cases must be resolved within the standard; 20% of the remaining cases must be resolved within 24 hours of the complaint.

indicators.meaning: Resolving specific consumer service connection faults (fuses, service line drops).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve an individual service connection fault within 12 hours in Rural Areas (excluding the night hours from 6:00 PM to 8:00 AM).
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 75% of cases must be resolved within the standard; 20% of the remaining cases must be resolved within 24 hours of the complaint.

indicators.meaning: Resolving specific consumer service connection faults (fuses, service line drops).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve an individual service connection fault within 24 hours in Hill Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 75% of cases must be resolved within the standard; 20% of the remaining cases must be resolved within 24 hours of the complaint.

indicators.meaning: Restoring power supply to a disconnected service connection following payment of dues.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must restore the supply to a disconnected service connection immediately and in any case not exceeding 6 working hours after the receipt of electricity charges and dues.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The performance level is expected to be maintained at 100% of cases.

indicators.meaning: Releasing new Low Tension (LT) service connection where existing distribution mains require no extension or improvement.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must give supply of electricity within 7 days (preferably within 3 days) of receiving a completed application requiring such supply.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of connections must be released within the specified time schedule.

indicators.indicator: LT Connection (Involving network extension without DTR)
indicators.meaning: Releasing new LT service connection where distribution mains extension is required but no new distribution transformer is needed.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete the network extension and release the connection within 60 days of receiving completed application/payments.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of connections must be released within the specified time schedule.

indicators.indicator: LT Connection (Involving network extension with DTR)
indicators.meaning: Releasing new LT service connection where distribution mains extension as well as commissioning of a new distribution transformer is required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete the transformer installation and release the connection within 90 days of receiving payments.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of connections must be released within the specified time schedule.

indicators.meaning: Releasing HT or EHT connection requiring network extension and improvements.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete HT extension within 60 days and EHT extension within 150 days of receiving payments.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of connections must be released within the specified time schedule.

indicators.indicator: HT / EHT Connection (Involving Power Transformer enhancement)
indicators.meaning: Releasing HT or EHT connection requiring addition or capacity enhancement of power transformers.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete power transformer addition/enhancement and release HT connection within 120 days and EHT connection within 180 days.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of connections must be released within the specified time schedule.

indicators.indicator: HT / EHT Connection (Involving New Substation Commissioning)
indicators.meaning: Releasing HT or EHT connection requiring the construction and commissioning of a new substation.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must commission a new substation and release HT connection within 270 days and EHT connection within 365 days.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of connections must be released within the specified time schedule.

indicators.indicator: Temporary Connection purely for Temporary Purposes (No system augmentation)
indicators.meaning: Providing supply for temporary purposes like circus, events, festivals, or illumination where no system augmentation is needed.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must provide temporary supply purely for temporary purposes not later than 48 hours where no system augmentation is required.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of temporary connections must be released within the specified limits.

indicators.indicator: Refund of Balance Deposit in Temporary Supply (Service Transfer)
indicators.meaning: Processing the refund or transfer of balance deposits on expiry of the temporary supply.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must transfer the balance temporary supply deposit to another active service within 7 days of receiving the consumer's option or disconnection.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of deposit refund cases must be completed within the specified timelines.

indicators.indicator: Refund of Balance Deposit in Temporary Supply (Bank Refund)
indicators.meaning: Processing the refund or transfer of balance deposits on expiry of the temporary supply.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must refund the balance temporary supply deposit to the consumer's bank account within 7 days of disconnection or receiving bank details.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of deposit refund cases must be completed within the specified timelines.

indicators.indicator: Shifting of Meter or Service Line
indicators.meaning: Shifting the meter or service line within consumer premises at the consumer's cost.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete the physical shifting of the meter or service connection within 25 days of receipt of payment and charges.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of shifting requests must be resolved within the specified timeline. (Regulation 23(5) cites 95%, Appendix target cites 90%).

indicators.meaning: Deviation or shifting of LT or HT overhead distribution lines at the consumer's request and cost.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete the shifting of HT or LT distribution lines within 60 days of receiving necessary expenses.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of line shifting requests must be resolved within the specified timeline. (Regulation 23(5) cites 95%, Appendix target cites 90%).

indicators.meaning: Relocating distribution transformer structures at the consumer's request and cost.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete the physical relocation of distribution transformer structures within 90 days of receiving necessary payments.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of shifting requests must be resolved within the specified timeline. (Regulation 23(5) cites 95%, Appendix target cites 90%).

indicators.indicator: Transfer of Service Connection / Title Transfer
indicators.meaning: Processing the transfer of connection ownership to a new applicant.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must effect the transfer of service connection within 7 days from the date of receipt of a complete application.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of transfer of service connection requests must be completed within the timeline.

indicators.meaning: Processing a request to change the consumer's tariff category.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must effect the change of tariff within 7 working days from the date of receipt of application from the consumer.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of change of tariff requests must be completed within the timeline.

indicators.indicator: Permanent Reduction of Demand (No meter change)
indicators.meaning: Processing permanent demand/load reduction where no metering change is required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must effect the permanent reduction of demand within 7 days of receiving the request when no metering system change is needed.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of load reduction requests must be completed within the timeline.

indicators.indicator: Permanent Reduction of Demand (With meter change)
indicators.meaning: Processing permanent demand/load reduction where metering changes are required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must effect the permanent reduction of demand within 4 weeks of receiving the request when a change in the metering system is required.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of load reduction requests must be completed within the timeline.

indicators.meaning: Correcting address, phone number, email ID, or other registration details.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must update and correct consumer registration details within 7 days of receiving supporting documents.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of consumer details updates must be completed within the timeline.

indicators.indicator: Billing Complaints Prior to Due Date
indicators.meaning: Resolving errors in bills before the due date for payment.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve any complaints in billing received prior to the due date before the next billing cycle, along with necessary adjustments.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of billing complaints must be resolved within the timeline.

indicators.meaning: Correcting simple arithmetic calculation errors in consumer accounts.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve arithmetic billing errors within the payment due date if the complaint is received at least 3 days prior to the due date.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of billing complaints must be resolved within the timeline.

indicators.meaning: Testing and replacing faulty, non-functional, creeping, stuck, or burnt meters.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace a malfunctioning, defective, or burnt meter within 7 days (non-availability of meters is not a valid reason for delay).
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of defective or burnt meter replacements must be completed within the specified timeline.

indicators.meaning: Conducting site visits and responding to power quality or voltage complaints in writing.
indicators.standard_specified: On receiving a quality of supply complaint, the licensee's representative must visit the site and convey proposing actions in writing within 10 days.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of voltage fluctuation and quality complaints must be resolved within the specified benchmarks.

indicators.meaning: Resolving verified voltage variation complaints without system expansion.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve voltage fluctuation complaints within 48 hours where no network expansion or enhancement is involved.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of voltage complaints must be rectified within the specified limits.

indicators.indicator: Voltage Rectification (LT upgrade / installation of capacitors)
indicators.meaning: Resolving verified voltage variation complaints with LT network upgrade.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve voltage fluctuation complaints within 60 days where up-gradation of the LT network, transformer, or capacitor installation is needed.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of voltage complaints must be rectified within the specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Resolving verified voltage variation complaints with HT network upgrade.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve voltage fluctuation complaints within 120 days where up-gradation of the HT network is involved.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of voltage complaints must be rectified within the specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Providing official responses to written letters sent by consumers to the Territorial Engineer.
indicators.standard_specified: The Territorial Engineer must send an initial reply within 10 days of receiving a consumer's letter and a complete substantive response within 20 days.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of written consumer complaints must receive responses within these timelines.

indicators.meaning: Keeping written appointments made to visit consumer premises.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must keep written appointments or provide at least 24 hours' notice of cancellation to the consumer.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of scheduled consumer appointments must be kept.

indicators.meaning: Accepting and handling consumer complaints at scheduled grievance offices.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee's representative must receive complaints on appointed days and times, and provide compensation if cancellation is not communicated.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 100% of scheduled grievance handling sessions must comply with standards.

frameworks.regulation:
Karnataka Electricity Regulatory
Commission Licensees' Standards of Performance) Regulations - 2004 | Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission (Rights of Consumers Relating to Supply of Electricity, Standards of Performance (SoP) and allied matters) Regulations, 2022.

indicators.meaning: Replacing blown Horn Gap (HG) or Low Tension (LT) fuses at distribution transformers or consumer premises.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace blown fuses and restore supply following normal fuse-off calls within 6 hours in Cities and Towns.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of fuse-off call complaints must be resolved within the specified timeline.

indicators.meaning: Replacing blown Horn Gap (HG) or Low Tension (LT) fuses at distribution transformers or consumer premises.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace blown fuses and restore supply following normal fuse-off calls within 24 hours in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of fuse-off call complaints must be resolved within the specified timeline.

indicators.meaning: Repairing overhead distribution lines or cables, excluding cases where poles are broken or uprooted.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve line breakdowns and restore supply within 6 hours in Cities and Towns (extended to 10 hours if poles are broken or uprooted).
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of line breakdowns must be rectified within the specified time limits.

indicators.meaning: Repairing overhead distribution lines or cables, excluding cases where poles are broken or uprooted.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve line breakdowns and restore supply within 24 hours in all cases in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of line breakdowns must be rectified within the specified time limits.

indicators.meaning: Restricting the number of scheduled or unscheduled power interruptions.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must limit power interruptions (scheduled or unscheduled) to a maximum of 2 interruptions per consumer per day in Urban Areas (including NJY feeders).
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98% of days must comply with the daily interruption limit in Urban Areas.

indicators.meaning: Restricting the number of scheduled or unscheduled power interruptions.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must limit power interruptions (scheduled or unscheduled) to a maximum of 3 interruptions per consumer per day in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of days must comply with the daily interruption limit in Rural Areas.

indicators.meaning: Restricting the cumulative duration of scheduled or unscheduled outages.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must limit the total duration of interruptions in a month to a maximum of 90 minutes in Urban Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98% of months must comply with the cumulative duration limit in Urban Areas.

indicators.meaning: Restricting the cumulative duration of scheduled or unscheduled outages.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must limit the total duration of interruptions in a month to a maximum of 180 minutes in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of months must comply with the cumulative duration limit in Rural Areas.

indicators.meaning: Replacing or repairing failed distribution transformers on the distribution network.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace or repair a failed distribution transformer and restore supply within 24 hours in Cities and Towns.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of transformer failures must be resolved within the specified timeline.

indicators.meaning: Replacing or repairing failed distribution transformers on the distribution network.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace or repair a failed distribution transformer and restore supply within 72 hours in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of transformer failures must be resolved within the specified timeline.

indicators.meaning: Restricting pre-arranged shut-downs of equipment and lines for system maintenance.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must limit the maximum duration of a scheduled maintenance outage to not exceed 12 hours in a single stretch.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of scheduled outages must comply with the maximum duration limit.

indicators.meaning: Ensuring timely restoration of supply after pre-planned maintenance.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must ensure power supply is fully restored by not later than 6:00 PM on any scheduled outage day.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of scheduled outages must have supply restored by 6:00 PM.

indicators.meaning: Resolving voltage fluctuation complaints where system expansion is not required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve voltage level complaints within 7 days when no network expansion or enhancement is involved.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of voltage variation complaints must be resolved within the specified timeline.

indicators.meaning: Resolving voltage fluctuation complaints requiring network capacity enhancement.
indicators.standard_specified: Where resolving voltage variations requires up-gradation or enhancement of the distribution system, the works must be completed within 120 days.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of voltage variation complaints must be resolved within the specified timeline.

indicators.meaning: Resolving issues of open neutral line and neutral-to-ground voltage deviations.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve open neutral issues and neutral voltage exceeding 2% of supply voltage within 6 hours in Cities.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of open neutral complaints must be resolved within the specified timeline.

indicators.meaning: Resolving issues of open neutral line and neutral-to-ground voltage deviations.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve open neutral issues and neutral voltage exceeding 2% of supply voltage within 24 hours in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of open neutral complaints must be resolved within the specified timeline.

indicators.indicator: Inspect and Check Correctness of Meters
indicators.meaning: Verifying meter accuracy upon receiving consumer complaints.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must inspect and verify the correctness of a disputed meter within 7 days of receiving the complaint.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of meter inspection requests must be completed within the specified timeline.

indicators.meaning: Testing and replacing defective, creeping, MNR, or stuck meters.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace defective, fast, slow, creeping, or stuck meters within 24 hours in Urban Areas and 72 hours in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of defective meter replacements must be completed within specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Replacing burnt meters where damage is due to system faults or utility error.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace a burnt meter (if cause is not attributable to the consumer) within 24 hours in Urban Areas and 72 hours in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of burnt meter replacements must be completed within specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Replacing burnt meters where damage is due to overloading, tampering, etc.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace a consumer-attributable burnt meter and restore supply within 24 hours in Urban Areas and 72 hours in Rural Areas after receiving payment of charges.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of consumer-side burnt meter replacements must be completed within specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Releasing new supply where the service is feasible from the existing network.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must release a new service connection within 7 days of receiving a completed application in Metro Cities.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of new connection requests must be serviced within the specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Releasing new supply where the service is feasible from the existing network.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must release a new service connection within 15 days of receiving a completed application in Other Municipal Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of new connection requests must be serviced within the specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Releasing new supply where the service is feasible from the existing network.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must release a new service connection within 30 days of receiving a completed application in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of new connection requests must be serviced within the specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Releasing LT supply where network enhancement or main extension is required.
indicators.standard_specified: Where LT connection requires distribution main extension, the licensee must release the supply within 45 days of receipt of application.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of network-dependent LT connections must be released within 45 days.

indicators.meaning: Releasing HT 11 KV supply where network expansion is required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must execute 11 KV network expansion and release supply within 60 days of receiving the application.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of network-dependent HT 11 KV connections must be released within 60 days.

indicators.meaning: Releasing HT 33 KV supply where network expansion is required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must execute 33 KV network expansion and release supply within 90 days of receiving the application.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of network-dependent HT 33 KV connections must be released within 90 days.

indicators.meaning: Releasing EHT supply where system expansion is required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must execute Extra High Tension (EHT) network expansion and release supply within 180 days of receiving the application.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of EHT connection requests must be serviced within 180 days.

indicators.meaning: Transfer of ownership, category conversion, or title modifications.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must process and complete title transfer of ownership or change of consumer category within 7 days of receiving the application.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of administrative service alteration requests must be completed within 7 days.

indicators.meaning: Executing service disconnections and physical line removals upon request.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must execute service disconnection and line shifting within 2 days for LT installations and within 5 days for HT installations in Urban Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of consumer-initiated disconnection requests must be processed within specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Executing service disconnections and physical line removals upon request.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must execute service disconnection and line shifting within 5 days for LT installations and within 7 days for HT installations in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of consumer-initiated disconnection requests must be processed within specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Changing single-phase LT lines to three-phase LT lines (and vice-versa) or LT to HT.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete line phase conversions or LT-to-HT conversions within 30 days from the date of payment of charges.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of conversion works must be completed within 30 days.

indicators.meaning: Correcting billing mistakes where no on-site investigation is required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve complaints and issue a revised bill within 24 hours of receipt if no field report is required.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of billing dispute complaints must be resolved within the specified timeline.

indicators.meaning: Correcting billing mistakes where on-site investigation is needed.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete the field inspection and issue a revised bill within 7 days of receiving a billing dispute complaint.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of billing dispute complaints must be resolved within the specified timeline.

indicators.meaning: Reconnecting supply following disconnection for non-payment upon dues settlement.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must restore supply on the same day of receiving payment from the disconnected consumer in Cities and Towns.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of urban reconnections must be completed on the same day.

indicators.meaning: Reconnecting supply following disconnection for non-payment upon dues settlement.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must restore supply within 24 hours of receiving payment from the disconnected consumer in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of rural reconnections must be completed within 24 hours.

indicators.meaning: Disbursing solatium compensation in cases of electrical accidents.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must disburse solatium within 7 days (without waiting for the CEIG report) in clear cases where the accident is not due to the victim's fault.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of solatium disbursements in clear cases must be executed within 7 days.

indicators.meaning: Disbursing solatium compensation in other electrical accident cases.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must disburse solatium within 30 days after receiving the report from the CEIG in all other accident cases.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of other solatium disbursements must be executed within 30 days of the CEIG report.

indicators.meaning: Returning security deposits or other deposits back to the consumer.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must refund consumer deposits within 60 days of receiving a valid refund request.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of deposit refunds must be executed within the 60-day limit.

indicators.meaning: Providing requested administrative or supply certificates to the consumer.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must issue any requested certificates on the same day of receiving the consumer's request.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of certificate issue requests must be completed on the same day.

indicators.meaning: Ensuring proper coverage of consumer meters during each billing cycle.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must bill 100% of metered active consumers within the designated billing cycle.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The utility must ensure 100% of the active consumer base is billed during each billing cycle.

indicators.meaning: Revenue collection benchmark against total billed energy for metered consumers.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must achieve a minimum collection efficiency of 98% for metered installations.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The cumulative revenue recovery rate must meet or exceed the 98% target.

indicators.meaning: Revenue collection benchmark against total billed energy for un-metered consumers.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must achieve a minimum collection efficiency of 85% for un-metered installations.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The cumulative revenue recovery rate must meet or exceed the 85% target.

indicators.meaning: Restricting the annual failure rate of distribution transformers (DTR) in urban grids.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must maintain the annual failure rate of distribution transformers at or below 3% in Urban Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The overall annual transformer breakdown percentage must not exceed 3% in urban networks.

indicators.meaning: Restricting the annual failure rate of distribution transformers (DTR) in rural grids.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must maintain the annual failure rate of distribution transformers at or below 7% in Rural Areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The overall annual transformer breakdown percentage must not exceed 7% in rural networks.

indicators.meaning: Managing the proportion of faulty/MNR/burnt/sticky meters in the network.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must limit the percentage of faulty meters in service (including MNR, burnt, sticky, and faulty units) to not exceed 1.5%.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The overall percentage of faulty active meters in service must be kept below the 1.5% ceiling.

indicators.meaning: Maintaining phase voltage within regulatory limits at the point of commencement of supply.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must maintain the terminal supply voltage on the LT system within the limits of +6% and -6%.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The terminal voltage across all LT consumers must fully comply with the ±6% variation boundaries.

indicators.meaning: Maintaining phase voltage within regulatory limits at the point of commencement of supply.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must maintain the terminal supply voltage on the HT system within the limits of +6% and -9%.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The terminal voltage across all HT consumers must fully comply with the +6% and -9% variation boundaries.

indicators.meaning: Maintaining phase voltage within regulatory limits at the point of commencement of supply.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must maintain the terminal supply voltage on the EHT system within the limits of +12.5% and -12.5%.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The terminal voltage across all EHT consumers must fully comply with the ±12.5% variation boundaries.

indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace blown fuses and restore supply following normal fuse-off calls within 4 working hours of receiving a complaint in cities and towns.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of total fuse-off calls received must be rectified within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Replacing Horn Gap (HG) or Low Tension (LT) fuses at distribution transformers or consumer premises.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace blown fuses and restore supply following normal fuse-off calls within 12 working hours of receiving a complaint in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of line breakdown cases must be resolved within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Repairing overhead distribution lines or cables, excluding cases with broken or uprooted poles.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve overhead line or cable breakdowns and restore supply within 6 hours of occurrence in cities and towns.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of line breakdown cases must be resolved within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Repairing overhead distribution lines or cables, excluding cases with broken or uprooted poles.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve overhead line or cable breakdowns and restore supply within 24 hours of occurrence in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of line breakdown cases must be resolved within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Locating, repairing, and re-energising the system following underground cable network faults.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve underground cable faults and restore supply within 12 hours of occurrence in cities and towns.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of line breakdown cases must be resolved within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Locating, repairing, and re-energising the system following underground cable network faults.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve underground cable faults and restore supply within 48 hours of occurrence in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of failed distribution transformers must be replaced within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Replacing or repairing failed distribution transformers and restoring consumer service lines.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace or repair a failed distribution transformer and restore supply within 24 hours of receiving the complaint in cities and towns.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of failed distribution transformers must be replaced within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Replacing or repairing failed distribution transformers and restoring consumer service lines.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace or repair a failed distribution transformer and restore supply within 48 working hours of receiving the complaint in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of scheduled outages must comply with the maximum daily duration standard.

indicators.meaning: Pre-arranged shut-downs of equipment and lines for necessary maintenance work.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must limit the maximum duration of a scheduled outage for system maintenance to not exceed 12 hours in a day.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 95% of scheduled outages must have supply restored by 6:00 PM.

indicators.meaning: Pre-arranged shut-downs of equipment and lines for necessary maintenance work.
indicators.standard_specified: During pre-arranged maintenance outages, the distribution licensee must ensure that the power supply is fully restored by not later than 6:00 PM.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of street light line faults must be resolved within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Rectifying overhead line faults and restoring streetlights.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must rectify line faults and restore streetlights within 24 hours of detection or receipt of a complaint, whichever is earlier.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 90% of defective street light fixtures must be replaced within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Replacing fused bulbs or rectifying/replacing defective street lighting units.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace the light or rectify/replace the unit within 24 hours of detection or receipt of a complaint, whichever is earlier, wherever responsible for maintenance.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The overall billing error rate requiring modifications must remain under the 0.1% ceiling.

indicators.meaning: Managing the error rate of issued bills requiring modifications.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must limit the percentage of bills requiring modifications following complaints to the total number of bills issued to not exceed 0.1.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of billing complaints must be resolved within specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Correcting billing errors where no additional on-site inspection or information is required.
indicators.standard_specified: When a billing complaint is received and no additional information is required, the licensee must resolve the dispute and issue a revised bill within 24 working hours of receipt of the complaint.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of billing complaints must be resolved within specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Correcting billing errors where additional on-site inspection or meter verification is required.
indicators.standard_specified: When a billing complaint is received and additional information or investigation is required, the licensee must resolve the dispute and issue a revised bill within 7 working days.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: The overall percentage of active faulty meters across the network must not exceed the 3% cap.

indicators.meaning: Maintaining overall meter health across the distribution network.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must maintain the percentage of defective meters in service at a value not greater than 3 of the total number of meters in service.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of meter complaints in cities and towns must be resolved within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Inspecting, checking correctness, and replacing reported malfunctioning meters in urban areas.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must inspect and check the correctness of a meter within 7 working days of complaint and, if found not working, replace it within 15 days thereafter in cities and towns.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98% of meter complaints in rural areas must be resolved within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Inspecting, checking correctness, and replacing reported malfunctioning meters in rural areas.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must inspect and check the correctness of a meter within 15 working days of complaint and, if found not working, replace it within 15 days thereafter in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of urban and 98% of rural burnt meter complaints must be resolved within specified standards.

indicators.meaning: Replacing burnt-out meters due to network failures (such as high voltage, loose contacts, or age).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace a burnt-out meter at its own cost within 24 hours in urban areas and 72 hours in rural areas from receipt of complaint, if the burning is due to licensee-attributable causes.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 99% of urban and 98% of rural burnt meter complaints must be resolved within specified standards.

indicators.meaning: Replacing burnt-out meters due to consumer overloading, tampering, or wet meters.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace a burnt-out meter within 24 hours in urban areas and 72 hours in rural areas of receiving the payment of meter cost from the consumer, if the burning is due to consumer causes.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98% of voltage unbalance issues must be successfully maintained within the specified threshold.

indicators.meaning: Maintaining supply voltage phase symmetry at the point of supply.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must ensure that the phase voltage unbalance does not exceed 3 at the point of commencement of supply.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98% of voltage fluctuation cases must be rectified within specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Resolving voltage level issues where distribution mains do not require expansion.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve voltage level complaints and bring voltages within prescribed limits (±6 for LT, +6/-9 for HT, +10/-12.5 for EHT) within 10 days of the complaint.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98% of voltage fluctuation cases must be rectified within specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Resolving voltage level issues where system network upgrade is required.
indicators.standard_specified: Where resolving voltage fluctuations requires system up-gradation or network enhancement, the distribution licensee must complete the works within 120 days.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98% of voltage fluctuation cases must be rectified within specified timelines.

indicators.meaning: Resolving voltage level issues when a new substation needs to be erected.
indicators.standard_specified: When resolving a voltage issue requires erecting a new substation, the utility must complete the installation and commission it within the timeframe approved by the Commission.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: All cases (100%) of release of connection must be completed within the specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Releasing supply where distribution mains are already in place.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must release a new electricity connection within 30 days of receiving a complete application accompanied by prescribed fees, charges, and security.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: All cases (100%) of release of connection must be completed within the specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Releasing 11 KV supply when network extension is required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete the network extension and release supply within 60 days of receipt of prescribed charges.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: All cases (100%) of release of connection must be completed within the specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Releasing 33 KV supply when network extension is required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete the network extension and release supply within 90 days of receipt of prescribed charges.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: All cases (100%) of release of connection must be completed within the specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Releasing EHT supply when transmission network extension is required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete the extra high tension network extension and release supply within 180 days of receipt of prescribed charges.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: All cases (100%) of release of connection must be completed within the specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Releasing supply when a new substation must be erected.
indicators.standard_specified: Where supply requires the commissioning of a new substation, the distribution licensee must supply electricity immediately after commissioning within a period not exceeding 90 days.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98% of administrative service requests must be completed within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Processing the transfer of ownership of a service connection to a new owner.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must process and finalize the transfer of ownership of a connection within 7 days of receiving the application with necessary documents and fee.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98% of administrative service requests must be completed within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Processing the change of consumer or tariff category.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must process and finalize the request for change of category within 7 days of receiving the application with necessary documents and fee.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98% of technical service requests must be completed within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Converting service lines from LT single-phase to LT three-phase (or vice-versa).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must execute and complete phase conversion from LT single-phase to LT three-phase (or vice-versa) within 30 days of payment of necessary charges.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98% of technical service requests must be completed within specified limits.

indicators.meaning: Converting service connections from Low Tension to High Tension (or vice-versa).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must execute and complete service conversion from Low Tension to High Tension (or vice-versa) within 60 days of payment of necessary charges.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: At least 98 of technical service requests must be completed within specified limits.

frameworks.regulation: West Bengal Electricity Regulatory Commission (Standards of Performance of Licensees Relating to Consumer Services) Regulations, 2010 | West Bengal Electricity Regulatory Commission (Standards of Performance of Licensees Relating to Consumer Services) (First Amendment) Regulations, 2013.

indicators.meaning: Restoring power supply by replacing blown fuses at distribution transformers or consumer premises.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace blown fuses and restore supply within 3 hours in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Restoring power supply by replacing blown fuses at distribution transformers or consumer premises during monsoon.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace blown fuses and restore supply within 8 hours during the Monsoon season (June to September) in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Restoring power supply by replacing blown fuses at distribution transformers or consumer premises during non-monsoon.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace blown fuses and restore supply within 6 hours during non-monsoon months (October to May) in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Repairing broken or snapped Low Tension (LT) overhead wires.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must repair snapped LT wires and restore supply within 4 hours in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Repairing broken or snapped Low Tension (LT) overhead wires during monsoon.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must repair snapped LT wires and restore supply within 16 hours during the Monsoon season (June to September) in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Repairing broken or snapped Low Tension (LT) overhead wires during non-monsoon.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must repair snapped LT wires and restore supply within 10 hours during non-monsoon months (October to May) in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: Falling of trees on overhead lines (Urban)
indicators.meaning: Clearing fallen trees or branches from LT and HT overhead lines without broken/uprooted poles.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must clear fallen trees and restore supply within 8 hours in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: Falling of trees on overhead lines (Rural)
indicators.meaning: Clearing fallen trees or branches from LT and HT overhead lines without broken/uprooted poles.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must clear fallen trees and restore supply within 24 hours in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Repairing short circuits on underground LT cable networks.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must repair LT underground cable short circuits and restore supply within 6 hours in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Repairing short circuits on overhead LT line networks.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must repair LT overhead line short circuits and restore supply within 3 hours in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Repairing short circuits on overhead LT line networks.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must repair LT overhead line short circuits and restore supply within 4 hours in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: 11 KV overhead line breakdown (Urban - No pole)
indicators.meaning: Resolving 11 KV overhead breakdowns where no poles are broken or need replacement.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must restore supply within 6 hours of an 11 KV line breakdown in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: 11 KV overhead line breakdown (Rural - No pole)
indicators.meaning: Resolving 11 KV overhead breakdowns where no poles are broken or need replacement.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must restore supply within 18 hours of an 11 KV line breakdown in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: 11 KV overhead line breakdown (Urban - Pole replacement)
indicators.meaning: Resolving breakdowns where poles are broken/uprooted and need replacement.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace broken poles and restore supply within 12 hours in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: 11 KV overhead line breakdown (Rural - Pole replacement)
indicators.meaning: Resolving breakdowns where poles are broken/uprooted and need replacement.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace broken poles and restore supply within 24 hours in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Repairing HT underground cable failures where a ring main supply system exists.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must restore power supply within 4 hours using alternative ring main feeds.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: HT underground cable fault (No Ring Main)
indicators.meaning: Repairing HT underground cable failures where no ring main system exists.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must isolate, repair, and restore supply within 24 hours where no ring main feed exists.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Replacing or repairing failed distribution transformers and restoring consumer service lines.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace or repair a failed distribution transformer and restore supply within 12 hours in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Replacing or repairing failed distribution transformers and restoring consumer service lines.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace or repair a failed distribution transformer and restore supply within 48 hours in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: LT line breakdowns for other reasons (Urban)
indicators.meaning: Resolving any other general LT line failures not categorized elsewhere.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve LT line failures and restore supply within 6 hours in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: LT line breakdowns for other reasons (Rural)
indicators.meaning: Resolving any other general LT line failures not categorized elsewhere.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve LT line failures and restore supply within 24 hours in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Restoring service lines directly feeding consumer premises.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve service line failures within 4 hours (Overhead) or 12 hours (Underground) in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Restoring service lines directly feeding consumer premises.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve service line failures within 18 hours (Overhead) or 24 hours (Underground) in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Correcting local voltage level anomalies.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve persistent local over/under voltage complaints within 15 days.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Correcting voltage level anomalies that require network restructuring.
indicators.standard_specified: Where voltage corrections require distribution system augmentation or line re-routing, the licensee must complete works within 6 months.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Attending to complaints regarding voltage fluctuation beyond State Grid Code limits.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve voltage fluctuation complaints within 4 days in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Attending to complaints regarding voltage fluctuation beyond State Grid Code limits.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must resolve voltage fluctuation complaints within 8 days in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: Defective Meter Inspection (Urban - No supply cut-off)
indicators.meaning: Inspecting malfunctioning, creeping, or stuck meters (Amended in 2013).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must inspect defective meters within 3 working days of receiving a complaint in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: Defective Meter Inspection (Rural - No supply cut-off)
indicators.meaning: Inspecting malfunctioning, creeping, or stuck meters (Amended in 2013).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must inspect defective meters within 7 working days of receiving a complaint in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: Burnt Meter Replacement (Urban - No supply cut-off)
indicators.meaning: Replacing burnt meters where supply remains live (Amended in 2013).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace a burnt meter within 7 working days of inspection in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: Burnt Meter Replacement (Rural - No supply cut-off)
indicators.meaning: Replacing burnt meters where supply remains live (Amended in 2013).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace a burnt meter within 15 working days of inspection in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Replacing or rectifying malfunctioning meters (Amended in 2013).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must test and replace defection meters within 20 days of inspection in both urban and rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Replacing faulty/burnt meters where supply is interrupted.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace a faulty meter and restore supply within 24 hours of complaint in urban areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Replacing faulty/burnt meters where supply is interrupted.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace a faulty meter and restore supply within 48 hours of complaint in rural areas.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Resealing accidental breakage of seals where no tampering is suspected.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must reseal meters within 24 hours of complaint or detection.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Replacing meters following seal breakage where replacement is required (Amended in 2013).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must replace meters with broken seals within 10 days of complaint or detection.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Conducting inspection and issuing estimates/quotations for new LV/MV connections.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must inspect premises and issue connection quotations within 14 days of receiving request.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Conducting inspection and issuing estimates/quotations for new LV/MV connections.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must inspect premises and issue connection quotations within 28 days of receiving request.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Conducting inspection and issuing estimates/quotations for HT supply.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must inspect and issue estimates within 30 days (11 KV), 45 days (33 KV), or 60 days (132 KV) of request.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Releasing new LT/MV connections where distribution mains exist.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must release a new electricity connection within 30 days of receiving a completed application (Form B).
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Releasing connections requiring distribution main augmentation but no additional poles (Amended in 2013).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must release the new connection within 60 days of application (Form B).
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Releasing connections requiring cable extension up to 100 metres (Amended in 2013).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must release the new connection within 60 days of application (Form B).
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Releasing connections requiring overhead line extension with additional poles (Amended in 2013).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must release the new connection within 90 days of application (Form B).
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Releasing connections requiring underground cable extension above 100 metres.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must release the new connection within 90 days of application (Form B).
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Releasing HV or EHV supply when network extension is required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must release new HV/EHV connections within 180 days of application (Form B).
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Installing new transformers or bays in existing substations.
indicators.standard_specified: The licensee must complete installation within 90 days (Distribution Substation), 150 days (33 KV Substation), or 270 days (132 KV Substation) of application.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Erecting and commissioning new substations to release connection.
indicators.standard_specified: The licensee must complete erection within 90 days (Distribution Substation), 300 days (33/11 KV Substation), or 540 days (132/33 KV Substation) of taking possession of land or ROW.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.type: Extension of Load for Existing Consumers
indicators.meaning: Increasing sanctioned load where existing lines can accommodate it.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must execute load extension within 30 days of application for consumers having overhead lines.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.type: Extension of Load for Existing Consumers
indicators.meaning: Increasing sanctioned load where cable augmentation is required.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must execute load extension within 45 days of application for consumers on underground cables.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.type: Extension of Load for Existing Consumers
indicators.meaning: Increasing sanctioned load requiring overhead line extension with no additional poles, additional poles, or UG cables.
indicators.standard_specified: The licensee must execute load extension within 45 days (No expansion), 60 days (OH - No poles), or 90 days (OH - Additional poles / UG cables) of application.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.type: Extension of Load for Existing Consumers
indicators.meaning: Increasing load requiring substation transformer or bay commissioning.
indicators.standard_specified: The licensee must complete substation works within 90 days (Distribution Substation), 150 days (33 KV Substation), or 270 days (132 KV Substation).
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: Alteration of Service (Meter / board within premises)
indicators.meaning: Processing requests to shift or alter meters/service lines within consumer boundaries.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete physical alterations within 30 days of application.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Shifting service lines or distribution equipment outside consumer boundaries.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete alterations within 90 days of application.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.indicator: Name Transfer / Purpose Conversion / Load Reduction
indicators.meaning: Transferring connection ownership, category conversion, or contract demand reduction (single application in Form A1).
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must complete transfer or conversion within the next billing cycle without discontinuing supply.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Processing requests for permanent service disconnection.
indicators.standard_specified: The distribution licensee must effect voluntary disconnection immediately within the notice period specified in the Supply Code.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: N/A

indicators.meaning: Restricting duration and ensuring prior notice of scheduled maintenance outages.
indicators.standard_specified: For pre-planned interruptions lasting more than 6 hours, the licensee must notify affected consumers at least 3 days in advance.
indicators.benchmark_meaning: Required via announcements, newspaper ads, radio/TV, or loudspeaker.
